description: This file defines the LanguageServiceProvider class for Drupal, which overrides and alters language management services, and includes methods for checking multilingual status and retrieving default language values.

classes.name: LanguageServiceProvider
classes.description: A service provider class that overrides and configures language services in Drupal.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers language-related services if the site is multilingual.

methods.name: alter
methods.description: Alters the language manager service definition to use a configurable class.

methods.name: isMultilingual
methods.description: Checks whether the site is configured as multilingual based on configuration storage.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguageValues
methods.description: Retrieves default language configuration values for the site.
